configuration: OpenAI dots with saved notes, self-timed follow-up, delegated tasks, and approval checks. The requested October 5 Markdown version could not be verified; findings below use the accessible HTML documentation.
sources_read: https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/dots — Meet dots; live HTML retrieved 2026-10-07.
https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/dots/tasks-and-memory — Tasks and memory; live HTML retrieved 2026-10-07.

S->M.label: reported
S->M.rationale: Research findings enter private notes; interaction-derived decisions and priorities can update persistent notes.
S->M.quote: keep private notes about useful findings

M->A.label: reported
M->A.rationale: Saved preferences, decisions, and work context inform subsequent assistance across conversations and contact methods.

A->S.label: reported
A->S.rationale: The dot checks results of tasks it created, directing observation toward its delegated execution.

M->S.label: reported
M->S.rationale: Background research relates new information to earlier work, exemplified by detecting conflict with a previously shared draft. Functionally, retained material supports interpretation.
M->S.quote: connect new information to earlier work

A->M.label: reported
A->M.rationale: Dot-issued task instructions enter separate conversations that remain available for continued coordination; saved schedules retain planned work.

record.label: stated
record.rationale: Delegation instructions and context enter task conversations that can be reopened and continued, retaining records of the service's commitments.
record.locator: [Tasks and memory](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/dots/tasks-and-memory), Assigned work, paragraph beginning 'A new task receives instructions'.

outcome.label: stated
outcome.rationale: Delegated execution returns results to the dot, and task-specific progress and results remain inspectable in Activity.
outcome.locator: [Tasks and memory](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/dots/tasks-and-memory), Assigned work, background-agent and Activity paragraphs.

attribution.label: stated
attribution.rationale: Results are associated with the tasks the dot initiated and checked to support task-specific follow-up instructions.
attribution.quote: Your dot can check results and send follow-up instructions to tasks it created.

revision.label: not_stated
revision.rationale: Updating task content and preferences is not mechanism revision; the described custom controls are user-supplied, with no service-authored mechanism change reported.
revision.locator: [Meet dots](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/dots), Permissions and approvals; [Tasks and memory](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/dots/tasks-and-memory), Persistent memory.

later_use.label: not_stated
later_use.rationale: Later assistance uses retained context, but no execution under a self-revised mechanism is reported.

notes: Independent text-only review; no code repository supplied. Quotes match the fetched HTML. Markdown retrieval failed, and no matching local snapshots were found, so the case-file hashes could not be checked. These judgments are provisional for the specified historical version. Pre-action approval checks were not counted as outcome attribution or self-revision.
